claims: As of April 2026, Tom Aspinall is the undisputed UFC Heavyweight Champion.
Tom Aspinall is an English fighter.
Tom Aspinall was promoted to undisputed champion in June 2025.
Tom Aspinall was promoted to undisputed champion following the retirement of Jon Jones.
Tom Aspinall previously held the interim heavyweight title.
Tom Aspinall won the interim heavyweight title in November 2023.
